name: Webwood Venom
summary: In Shadowglen, Gilshalan Windwalker studies the giant webwood spiders of Shadowthread Cave. He asks young night elves to gather venom sacs so he can learn how Teldrassil's growth has affected the forest's wildlife.

sections.title: A Naturalist's Curiosity
sections.body: Gilshalan Windwalker has come to Shadowglen to study the webwood spiders in Shadowthread Cave. They are far larger and more aggressive than their cousins elsewhere. He suspects Teldrassil's immense magical energies are changing the local wildlife. He asks for venom sacs to compare with those of ordinary spiders and learn what has changed.

sections.title: The Looming Threat in Shadowglen
sections.body: Webwood spiders live in and around Shadowthread Cave, where they threaten young night elves in the glen. Gathering their venom can help thin their numbers and give Darnassian researchers evidence of Teldrassil's effect on the wild.

faq.answer: Gilshalan Windwalker is a night elf researcher at Aldrassil in Shadowglen. He studies Teldrassil's wildlife to learn how the World Tree's rapid growth affects the local ecology.

faq.q: Why are the webwood spiders so large?
faq.answer: Webwood spiders are cousins to much smaller varieties. Gilshalan Windwalker believes Teldrassil's rapid growth and latent magical forces have enlarged them and changed their behavior.
Shadowthread Cave lies in northern Shadowglen, in the rocky ridges beyond Aldrassil's training grounds.

faq.q: What will Gilshalan do with the venom sacs?
faq.answer: Gilshalan plans to take the venom to Darnassus and compare its chemical and magical properties with those of ordinary forest spiders. He hopes to find signs of changes caused by the World Tree.

faq.q: Are there other quests in Shadowthread Cave?
faq.answer: Yes. Near Shadowthread Cave, Dirania Silvershine helps Iverron, an elf poisoned by the same spiders.
After studying the venom, Gilshalan asks for a Webwood Egg from deep inside Shadowthread Cave so he can study the spiders' life cycle.

angles.text: For young night elves coming of age in Shadowglen, this work offers an early lesson in how fragile and unpredictable nature has become beneath Teldrassil's boughs.
As a druid, you have reason to follow Gilshalan's findings. The Cenarion Circle watches closely to learn whether Teldrassil heals or warps the wildlife around it.
